result:
I removed the `Date#to_s` monkey-patch and converted the date interpolations I found to `to_fs(:default)`. I didn't run any specs, and the audit was grep-based, so I can't promise it caught every use. I also didn't run the `homologacao` skill, so nothing has been checked against the real screens, PDFs, spreadsheets or notifications.

- **Removed:** `config/initializers/fix_rails7_date_format.rb`. I also deleted `spec/initializers/fix_rails7_date_format_spec.rb`, because it only tested the patch. I did not add a replacement spec asserting that `Date#to_s` is back to ISO and takes no argument.
- **Date format kept:** `Date::DATE_FORMATS[:default]` is set in `config/initializers/datetime.rb`, not in the patch file, so `to_fs(:default)` still gives `dd/mm/aaaa`.
- **Converted to explicit `to_fs(:default)`:**
  - `app/helpers/professors_helper.rb`: affiliation start and end dates in the HTML table.
  - `app/models/admissions/filled_form_field_scholarity.rb`: the date range shown in parentheses.
  - `app/helpers/admissions/admission_processes_pdf_helper.rb`: process start and end dates in the PDF title.
- **No `Date#to_s(argument)` calls left:** a grep of `app`, `lib` and `config` found none.
- **Left unchanged:**
  - `enrollment_search_concern.rb` interpolates a string it builds itself into SQL, not a `Date`.
  - The PDF and scholarship helpers already format dates through `I18n.localize`.
  - `enrollment_requests_helper.rb` interpolates `created_at`, which is a `Time` and was never affected.

I did not audit `to_param`, URLs, cache keys, filenames or Liquid templates. Any date that reaches one of those now comes out as ISO (`2023-08-17`).
